CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 02 / 12

Costs, revenue and profit

Accounting and economic profit會計與經濟利潤

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate accounting profit as revenue minus explicit costs and economic profit as revenue minus both explicit and implicit costs. Interpret zero economic profit as covering all opportunity costs.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

會計利潤扣顯性成本；經濟利潤再扣隱性成本。零經濟利潤已補償老闆等自有資源的機會成本。

Accounting profit subtracts explicit costs from revenue. Economic profit also subtracts implicit costs. Zero economic profit covers all opportunity costs, including the owner's normal return.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TR=1,000, explicit=600, implicit=300. Accounting profit=400, economic profit=100. 兩種利潤相差隱性成本。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

TR=500, explicit=300, implicit=200. Economic profit? 經濟利潤？
